Title: Allan Chekwech’s Pivotal Academic Career at GSMC
NewsSummary: Allan's newsroom journey included a pivotal stop at AKU where he expanded his expertise
NewsContent:
​

Allan Chekwech, Acting Managing Editor at Nation Media Group Uganda, is no stranger to the media industry. With years of experience under his belt, he was already an accomplished professional when he chose to embark on the Executive Master's in Media Leadership and Innovation (EMMLI) programme at Aga Khan University's Graduate School of Media and Communications (GSMC). Despite his success, Allan recognized the need for more: a programme that would provide a practical and forward-looking approach to leadership and innovation in the fast-evolving world of media.  

Reflecting on his decision, Allan describes his time at AKU as nothing short of transformative. “The programme offered far more than I expected," he says. “It was a perfect blend of theory and practical application, covering critical areas like entrepreneurship, leadership, finance, media ethics, and human resource management."  

Before enrolling, Allan never imagined himself taking on roles such as drafting budgets or conducting customer proposition studies. “Now, these are part of my daily routine, and I feel confident applying these skills in my role as managing editor," he adds. The practical skills learned at GSMC have not only broadened his expertise but have also helped him tackle the dynamic challenges of media management.  

One of the most significant challenges Allan faced during his studies was balancing the rigorous demands of a high-pressure job with his academic responsibilities. As the head of production at Nation Media Group, he had little room to spare. “Time management was definitely a challenge, especially during the final semester," Allan admits. “Being a managing editor while pursuing this degree required a lot of discipline and focus. But the knowledge and skills I gained made every sacrifice worthwhile."

Despite these challenges, Allan found the experience to be deeply rewarding. He credits the programme's balance between theory and practice as one of its key strengths. “The ability to apply what we learned in real-time was invaluable. I felt like I was constantly evolving, both personally and professionally," he reflects.  

Looking forward, Allan is eager to leverage the knowledge, skills, and networks he gained from AKU to drive innovation and collaboration within the media industry. The connections he made with classmates, faculty, and industry leaders have been especially impactful. “The relationships I built at EMMLI are priceless," Allan says. “We're not just alumni—we're a community dedicated to advancing the media industry. I want to use this network to create platforms for sharing insights, publishing experiences, and mentoring the next generation of media professionals."  

For Allan, the journey at GSMC didn't just enhance his career—it deepened his commitment to shaping the future of media in Uganda and beyond. He's determined to make a lasting impact by fostering collaboration and encouraging innovation within the industry.
